thread:
lucy: Massive thanks to Facilities for the midnight fridge rescue. My tart survived because of you all :pray:
omar: shoutout to @facilities and @tess for heroically salvaging the spread. also props to snackbot for the 'Leftovers?' nudge at 6am :robot_face:
tess: I just grabbed some cling wrap and duct tape (kidding about the tape). happy everyone got to eat! :grin:
facilities: Team effort — left a tiny note on the fridge and we swapped the busted shelf. No charge. :wrench:
lucy: really appreciate that. can we send a little ramen/bagel run to the crew as thanks? nominating @people-ops to coordinate :point_up:
people-ops: Love this. We'll send a $25 coffee card and a thank-you sticker set. If anyone else wants to contribute, DM me. Also adding Facilities to the kudos board :star2:
omar: quick poll: next office snack day theme? react with :one: for "Breakfast", :two: for "Tropical", :three: for "Comfort Food"
tess: :one: for breakfast from me. also placed a tiny jar of gratitude on the counter for Facilities :cookie:
snackbot: Reminder scheduled: "Office Snack Day" on Friday 12:00. (reminder created)
people-ops: Sending a short email to leadership to highlight Facilities' quick response — small gestures like this keep the office running smoothly :email:
notes: thread is casual kudos and logistics
contains bot messages and a short poll
